name: Houston
living: distant lightning flickers inside the thunderclouds every so often, briefly lighting the glass towers (storm flash)
the vintage steam locomotive puffs soft white smoke that curls and drifts left along the trestle
the train's carriage windows glow warm and its headlamp flickers
the little signal light on the trestle blinks slowly from red to amber
heavy storm clouds roll slowly across the sky (sky layer drift)
glass-tower windows flicker and a red aircraft light blinks atop the tallest tower
the video board's pixel baseball streaks across the screen after a home run
floodlight banks glow and softly pulse, fine mist drifting through the cones
crowd shimmer in the right-field stands, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
